stack: Next.js mobile-first website and server routes
Cloudflare Stream for approved clip video delivery
A small background worker for clip preparation
Gemini API paid tier for assisted video analysis
assumptions: French is the first interface language; English follows after the pilot.
The pilot catalogue is public after an age and content warning; public sign-up and members-only clips are not assumed in the first release.
Only a project editor can submit or approve media; visitors can browse and submit a rate-limited report without an account.
Partners supply source files through a documented, approved route; no platform scraping or automatic VOD downloading is planned.
The worker suggests clips and prepares drafts, but a human approves every publication.
Gemini is a provisional paid-tier choice; partner footage is never sent to a free tier. Model quality, data terms, and cost must be validated before use.
A managed video provider is proposed to avoid operating transcoding and delivery servers; costs and EU data-processing terms need review.
The map describes a possible architecture, not existing code or a committed technology decision.

questions.question: Will the MVP include public accounts and members-only clips, or stay public after the age warning?
What exact partner-approved route will provide video files, and what separate game/music rights clearance is required before processing?
Should English subtitles and pages be included in the first public pilot, or added after French validation?
